subject: A single model neuron: input current, a leaky membrane, a firing threshold and an output axon.

entities.name: Membrane
entities.appearance: The boundary of the cell that holds the voltage difference.
entities.quote: Membrane: The boundary that holds the voltage difference.

entities.name: Input current
entities.appearance: An external drive flowing into the neuron.
entities.quote: Input current: The external drive into our model neuron, measured in nanoamps.

entities.name: Axon
entities.appearance: An output path leading away from the cell body.
entities.quote: Axon: The output path that carries the neuron’s signal away from its cell body.

entities.name: Leak
entities.appearance: A pull of the voltage back toward rest.
entities.quote: Leak: The tendency for the membrane voltage to move back toward rest.

entities.name: Threshold
entities.appearance: A voltage level at which a spike is emitted.
entities.quote: Threshold: The voltage at which the model emits a spike: -50 mV.

entities.name: Spike
entities.appearance: A sharp line in the voltage trace.
entities.quote: Spike: A discrete output event, drawn as a sharp line in the trace.
